missing_evidence: Payment service spans/metrics showing its own latency or timeout cause
Order service logs/metrics for the /v1/orders handler and its payment client timeout setting
candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its call to order (/v1/orders) hits a transport ReadTimeout; order's own call to payment (/v1/authorizations) also times out, so the latency originates downstream of the gateway, at order/payment.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment ReadTimeout but no payment-side spans/metrics; cannot yet distinguish payment slowness from order-side timeout config.

report.explanation: All four checkout requests return 502 at ~2s. Traces show gateway->order and order->payment transport ReadTimeouts, while inventory/redis calls succeed quickly. The failure is a downstream timeout propagating up, not a gateway-local fault. Payment-side evidence is absent, so the exact slow hop is bounded but not pinpointed.
